checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Entire image neutral black and white, no red or colour remaining
must.why: Looks fully grayscale. The car is a light grey, with no visible red or tint.

must.item: Same hatchback, same position, unchanged body details
must.why: Same car, pose, wheels, badge and plate position. The plate and badge are too small to check closely.

must.item: Street and background keep position and appearance apart from colour
must.why: Trees, houses, parked cars, pole and shadow all match the original.

must.item: Full composition retained, no cropping, same shape
must.why: Same framing and aspect ratio as the original.

faults.what: The car's red was mapped to a fairly light grey, so the car looks lighter and flatter than a standard desaturation would make it. The tonal contrast differs a little from the original.
The licence plate and badge are tiny, so small AI changes there can't be ruled out.

summary: A clean black and white version with the framing and details intact; the only issue is that the car's red came out as a slightly light grey.
